data.title: Beneficiary Change Velocity Anomaly
data.description: Detects multiple beneficiary additions or modifications on a single account within a short time window. Rapid beneficiary changes are a strong pre-cursor to payment diversion fraud, where an attacker positions new destination accounts before initiating unauthorized wires.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Beneficiary Change Velocity Anomaly")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct beneficiary_id) by account_id > 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:core_banking (event_type="BENEFICIARY_ADD" OR event_type="BENEFICIARY_MODIFY" OR event_type="BENEFICIARY_DELETE")
| stats dc(beneficiary_id) as unique_beneficiary_id by account_id
| where unique_beneficiary_id > 3

falsepositives: Corporate treasury teams onboarding multiple new vendors during month-end
Business accounts setting up payroll beneficiaries for the first time
